description:
Application s to install air-conditioning to five bedrooms, installing two external condensing units.  The property is end of terrace.  One external unit would be situated in the front garden at ground level, close to the boundary wall (between 29 and 31).  It would not be visible from the street as it would shelter behind a bike shed which in turn is shielded by a hedge. The ducting for this unit would be run externally on the front elevation of the property using a black fake 'drainpipe' ducting. It would mirror the black drainpipes on the front elevations of the properties in our terrace.

The second unit would be situated at the back of the property, level with our second floor.  It would be adjacent to our property wall above a section of flat roof and facing open space. There is no direct neighbour and the nearest property would be more than 60ft away. 

Only two bedrooms are occupied full time at present, and the motivation for the installation is to be able to heat individual rooms during the winter without using central heating, and to cool in the summer when necessary. It is unlikely that all five bedroom Units would be in operation at any given time, unless we had guests. However, the other bedrooms are used as workspaces and the air conditioning to these rooms will allow us to heat/cool these rooms individually. The condensers being considered Daikin RXA35A8 (if for a single room) 550h x 840w x 350d, and Daikin 2MXM68A9 for multiple units 734 x 974 x 408. https://www.daikin.co.uk/en_gb/products/product.html/2MXM-A9.html
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed 10208A01005, 10208A01004, 10208A01001, Multi model application Air Conditioning Technical Data 4MXM-A8 by DAIKIN [received 1st April 2026], Daikin Air Conditioning Stylish FTXA35CW-RXA35A8 Wall Mounted R32 by The Air Conditioning and Cooling Company London [received 1st April 2026]
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - All external materials used in the construction of the development hereby approved shall match the type, texture, tone, colour, size and profile of those used on the existing building and shall be retained permanently.

The timber enclosure shall either be natural wood in a similar tone as the yellow brickwork to the host site, or painted white to match the white render details on the property.

The mock rainwater pipe shall be black to match the pipes seen on other properties in the area.

Reason: In the interest of the appearance of the development and to safeguard visual amenity of the conservation area, in accordance with Council policies LP1, LP2 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
